script: HOOK (0–3s): Tight shot on the mustard-yellow wall. The left clock's second hand snaps to 6:00 PM and freezes mid-sweep. No voiceover. The stillness is the hook. SETUP (3–10s): Camera holds. Both clocks visible. Left labeled 'Us' — frozen. Right unlabeled — running. VO begins: 'Your clock stopped. Theirs didn't. You close at six. You respond fast — during business hours.' ESCALATION (10–18s): The right clock moves to 11:30 PM. A hand enters frame and writes 'Them' on the right clock. Camera pulls back slightly to frame both. VO: 'But the prospect doing serious research at midnight? They're not on your schedule. One unanswered question at the wrong hour, and they move to whoever was there.' RESOLUTION (18–25s): A phone enters the lower frame — screen shows an active AI chat interface responding at 12:43 AM. The left clock's second hand begins moving. Both clocks now run together. VO: 'Your website doesn't have to sleep. Create your AI assistant — let your website keep running when you can't.'
concept: A single mustard-yellow wall holds two identical white-faced analog clocks. The left clock is labeled 'Us' in small handwritten text — its second hand snaps to 6:00 PM and freezes. The right clock has no label and keeps running. Time passes. The right clock reaches 11:30 PM, then midnight. A hand enters frame and writes 'Them' on the right clock. Both clocks are visible together — one frozen, one alive. A phone screen enters the lower frame showing an active AI chat reply at 12:43 AM. Then the left clock's second hand begins moving again. Both clocks run in sync. The wall is the entire world. Time is the only actor.
